Is there any application processing fee?
Candidates pay Rs. 1000/- as the basic application processing fee with their Admission Forms.
What is the criterion for Diploma Students?
Candidates holding a 3-year Diploma from DAE (equivalent to Intermediate) are eligible for admission if their scores are equivalent
or above 60%. Candidates must bring their IBCC Equivalence Certificate of DAE.
Diploma holders of 1 and 2 years are not eligible for admission.
What is the credit transfer policy from other universities?
The University will entertain students who want to transfer to DSU from other HEC recognized universities. This will only be
possible if their cases are compliant with the University’s laid down rules for transfer of credits.
What is the last date for the submission of form?
As notified by the Admissions Office.
What is the procedure for taking admission in DSU for international students?
The foreign applicants have to go through the process as per HEC (Higher Education Commission Pakistan) rules and regulations.
The Fee Structure for foreign students is different.
How do I apply for financial aid?
Students have to submit the complete fee at the time of admission, but for the subsequent semesters, the following
scholarships/interest-free loan facilities are available for students:
1. Merit-based Scholarship
2. Need-based Scholarship
3. Interest-free Loan from Ihsan Trust
4. Facility to pay Semester Fee in 2-3 installments
